resources.string: Calls from anyone who is not a verified contact are declined without ringing and shown in Recent as a blocked call. A contact whose phone cannot prove who it is before ringing (for example after a long time apart) is declined too; call them back from Recent.
Their calls are declined without ringing and their live streams are hidden from Watch. They are not told. Only this phone knows.
Block someone from Recent (press and hold a row), from a contact, or with Decline and block on an incoming call.
Their calls will ring again and their live streams will show in Watch.
The block list cannot be read right now. Calls are not blocked until it can. Tap to reset it.
Everyone is unblocked and you can block people again.

Their calls will be declined without ringing and their live streams hidden from Watch. They are not told.\n\nThis works while their phone shows its real ID before the call rings: your verified contacts, and phones that do not hide their ID. A person who is not your contact normally calls under a one-time ID that changes on every call, and cannot be recognised. To stop those calls, turn on Block unknown callers in Settings.
The block list is full. Unblock someone first.
Could not save the block. The block list cannot be read right now.

This caller hides who they are until you answer, using a one-time ID that changes on every call, so this phone cannot recognise them next time.\n\nTo stop calls from people who are not your contacts, turn on Block unknown callers.
